topic.title: Sites of Special Scientific Interest / Assent / Consent
topic.source_contract: SSSI identity and notified features, operations likely to damage, owner or public-body route, Natural England notice, consent or assent decision and conditions, works, mitigation, compliance and feature-condition evidence

scope_guards: Proximity to an SSSI is not proof of an effect on notified features.
A planning consultation is not SSSI consent or assent.
Natural England advice is not a formal decision.
A consent application is not granted consent.
Planning permission is not a substitute for required SSSI consent or assent.
Completed works are not treated as compliant without condition evidence.
Mitigation installation is not measured feature recovery.
No score or promotion is written without exact decision, conditions, works, compliance and feature evidence.
